blind.description: A square-profile rustic chimney stack built from stacked rounded cobblestones/fieldstones with a flat, square grey slate or stone cap on top. Openings or vents are visible near the top beneath the cap, showing soot/smoke staining. The stones are cream, beige, and tan coloured, with patches of green moss growing in the crevices between stones. Surfaces are solid and contiguous with stylized stylized hand-painted cartoon textures, standing directly on its flat bottom with no extra base.
blind.from_above: A square grey slab with weathered, textured stone detailing and softly rounded, slightly chipped edges.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (dark soot shading inside and around the top vent openings)
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 ft wide.
